text.content:
Every heroic skill in one place, deduplicated; each retains its printed Requirements line. Core heroics are verbatim from the Core Rulebook Heroic Skills chapter (class names updated to their campaign register); supplement/homebrew heroics are as-sourced by their class's binder entry.

A BIT OF THE OLD ROUGH

Requirements: you must have mastered Prizefighter.

When you perform the Attack action with a melee brawling or spear weapon and have no other weapons equipped, you may make two separate attacks instead of one, targeting the same or different enemies. Both attacks follow the two-weapon fighting rules — each loses the multi property and cannot gain it, and each treats the High Roll as 0. If the first attack hits a creature, that creature becomes broken until the start of your next turn: a broken creature takes extra damage equal to your Skill Level in Adrenaline, then stops being broken. Broken is a primed condition — it is not a seventh status effect, no cleanse removes it, and it is private to this Heroic Skill. All damage from this Heroic Skill ignores Resistances. This Heroic Skill does not stack with a custom weapon's quick customisation.

ADVERSITY

Requirements: you must have mastered Blackguard. As long as you are suffering from one or more status effects, you gain a +1 bonus on all Checks for every status effect you are suffering from, and you deal 2 extra damage for every status effect you are suffering from (be it with attacks, spells, Arcana, items or any other method).

ALL YOU CAN EAT

Requirements: you must have mastered Cook.

Combine four ingredients into a delicacy.

AMBIDEXTROUS

(no requirement) You may apply the benefits of two-weapon fighting (page 69) to weapons belonging to different Categories, even if one is a melee weapon and the other is a ranged weapon (such as a dagger and a firearm, for instance). As long as you have exactly two weapons equipped and they share no Categories with each other, you gain a +2 bonus to Defense and the second attack you perform during each of your turns deals 5 extra damage.

ANATOMIST

Requirements: you must have mastered Fury, Archivist, Sharpshooter or Prizefighter, and acquired Knowledge is Power.

Whenever you acquire this Heroic Skill, choose two Species among beast, construct, demon, elemental, monster, plant, and undead.

When you deal damage to a creature belonging to the humanoid Species or to a Species you have chosen for this Heroic Skill, you may choose one option: you deal 5 extra damage to that creature; or that creature becomes reeling until the end of the scene. When a reeling creature recovers Hit Points and/or Mind Points, instead that creature recovers half the normal amount of HP and/or MP and is no longer reeling.

This Heroic Skill can be acquired up to three times.

ANOTHER WAY

Requirements: You must have mastered the Evangelist or Orator class.

When your actions replace an NPC's dark trait with a temporary questioning trait, you can spend a Fabula point and say something to help that NPC see the world in a new way. The next time you meet this NPC, their questioning trait will be replaced by a trait inspired by what you said, and cannot be a new dark trait.

APOTHEOSIS

Requirements: you must have mastered Penny Knight.

When you enter the Panoply, you may spend 1 Fabula Point to invoke your Theme. If you do, your entry deals 5 extra damage; and until the Panoply ends, you gain Immunity to your element, your element's damage-bypass clause applies, and once per Check you may spend 10 Mind Points to reroll either or both dice (the result cannot be a fumble). Once per rest.

ARCANE ECHOES

Requirements: you must have mastered Arcanist. When you successfully perform a Check to fill or erase one or more sections of a Clock, if the domains of one or more Arcana you have bound are applicable to the Check in question, you may fill or erase 1 additional section of that Clock. The Game Master has final say on whether a given domain applies or not.

ARCANE MARK

Requirements: you must have mastered Prizefighter.

When you hit one or more creatures with an arcane weapon, your attack deals 5 extra damage and you may choose one creature hit: if the next offensive spell you cast this scene targets only that creature, its Magic Check triggers a critical success if both dice show the same number, provided the Check is not a fumble.

ARCANE SACRIFICE

Requirements: you must have mastered Arcanist or Guardian.

Once per scene, when you and/or one or more allies you can see are reduced to 0 Hit Points, if you are merged with an Arcanum, you may have all creatures that would be reduced to 0 Hit Points be reduced to exactly 1 Hit Point instead. If you do, you must immediately dismiss that Arcanum (without applying any dismiss effect), and cannot summon that same Arcanum again until the end of the scene.

ARCANE THORNS

Requirements: you must have mastered Arcanist.

After an enemy causes you to lose Hit Points with an attack, spell, or Skill action, if you are merged with an Arcanum, you may choose physical damage or choose one damage type that Arcanum is granting you Resistance to. If you do, deal 5 damage of the chosen type to that enemy (after the effects of that enemy's attack, spell, or action have been resolved).

BATTLEFIELD INVESTIGATOR

Requirements: you must have mastered Captain or Archivist.

When you perform a Check to examine a creature, item or location during a conflict scene, you may memorize the High Roll of that Check. If you do, you cannot memorize High Rolls this way until the start of your next turn.

When a source deals damage to one or more creatures you can see, you may forget one of your memorized High Rolls to choose one option: that source deals extra damage to each creature equal to the forgotten High Roll; or reduce damage dealt by that source to each creature by an amount equal to the forgotten High Roll (before applying Affinities).

You automatically forget all memorized High Rolls at the end of each scene.

BEND MAGIC

Requirements: you must have mastered Dowser.

React to enemy spells with your invocations.

BLACK & WHITE

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Cartomancer, Blackguard, Entropist, and Spiritist.

When you resolve the Double Trouble effect, you may have all of its damage become light or dark (instead of being of a type matching the suits of the resolved cards). Additionally, as long as there is a joker in your discard pile, all damage dealt by your Blinding Flush, Double Trouble, and Magic Flush effects ignores Immunities and Resistances.

BLACK MARKET

Requirements: you must have mastered the Bounty Hunter Class.

When you are present in an area where rest costs at least 10 zenit, you have access to at least one shop that has connections to a secret network of goods for sale. This shop sells up to three items that cost up to 500 zenit more than the suggested maximum item value for your party.

BLADE ADEPT

Requirements: you must have mastered Prizefighter, and you must have at least one melee dagger weapon equipped.

While you have one or more melee dagger weapons equipped, you gain +1 Defense and +1 Magic Defense; those dagger weapons also count as belonging to the brawling, sword and thrown Categories for the purpose of Skills and effects; and your dagger-Category attacks may target creatures that melee attacks cannot normally reach.

BLOOD RITUALS

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Butcher, Blackguard, and Mutant, and acquired the Vismagus Skill.

When you perform a Ritual, if you don't have enough Mind Points to pay for its total cost, you may choose to pay for part of its Mind Point cost using Hit Points, spending Hit Points equal to twice the Mind Point cost paid this way. You cannot use this Skill if doing so would reduce you to 0 Hit Points. If a Ritual performed this way would cause you or an ally supporting its Magic Check to recover Hit Points or be otherwise healed, instead you each recover no Hit Points and are not healed (the Ritual functions normally on any other target).

When you use the Vismagus Skill, you can use Hit Points to pay only part of the Mind Point cost, spending Hit Points equal to twice the Mind Point cost paid this way. When you do so, the other restrictions on Vismagus still apply.

BRAINWAVE DISCHARGE

Requirements: you must have mastered Sensitive.

While your Brainwave Clock is full, you may use an action to erase all of its sections. If you do, you may choose one option: you deal 20 physical damage to every enemy that is present on the scene, or you deal 30 physical damage to a single enemy you can see. This amount increases by 10 if you are level 20 or higher, or by 20 if you are level 40 or higher.

BRAVE BASH

Requirements: you must have mastered Prizefighter.

When you use the Bone Crusher Skill against only one creature and you have a shield equipped, that creature becomes challenged until the end of your next turn: it must include you among the targets of its attacks and offensive spells, if able. Once per turn — including other creatures' turns — you may deal 5 extra damage to that creature with a free attack using a one-handed melee weapon. The challenge ends if another creature challenges it, or if you challenge a different creature.

BREAKER OF CHAINS

Requirements: You must have mastered one or more Classes among Unchained or Fury class.

Once per conflict, when making a melee attack, you can spend up to your total level in HP. If this attack connects, it deals additional damage equal to that number.

BUMBLING IDIOT

Requirements: You have mastered the Mountebank class and have obtained the WHOOPS! skill.

Whenever you get a Fumble, choose any number of creatures you can see: Each of them suffers either 10 physical damage or Shaken, your choice. This damage increases to 20 when you are level 20 or above, or 30 when you are level 40 or above.

COMPREHENSIVE INSULT

Requirements: you must have mastered the Malefactor.

You learn the ultimate Malefactor spell: Comprehensive Insult.

Comprehensive Insult · 40 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You assault the target's body with a sensory onslaught. All stimuli, from pleasure to pain, light up at the same time. The target suffers dazed, enraged, poisoned, shaken, slow, and weak.

CARD VANGUARD

Requirements: you must have mastered the Cartomancer Class.

When you discard cards due to the Magic Cards Skill, you may choose 1 of them and place it face down in front of you as a vanguard card instead of putting it into your discard pile. You may only do so if you have two or fewer vanguard cards in play.

When a source deals damage to you and/or one or more allies you can see, you may reveal one of your vanguard cards in play. If you do and that card is a joker or its suit matches the damage type dealt by that source, you and every ally you can see gain Resistance to that damage type until the end of the current turn; then, put the revealed vanguard card on top of your discard pile, and it stops being a vanguard card.

You may look at your vanguard cards at any time. At the end of each conflict, if you have one or more vanguard cards in play, shuffle them back into your deck.

CATEGORY TRAINING

When you acquire this Heroic Skill, choose one weapon Category among arcane, bow, brawling, dagger, firearm, flail, heavy, spear, sword, and thrown. You gain the ability to equip martial weapons (W) that belong to the chosen Category, and gain a +2 bonus to Accuracy Checks with them. Additionally, your attacks with weapons that belong to the chosen Category deal 5 extra damage and cannot benefit from extra damage granted by the Powerful Shot and Powerful Strike Heroic Skills.

CEASELESS BATTLEFIELD

Requirements: you must have mastered Captain.

The MP costs for your Bishop's Edict, Charging Cavalry and King's Castle are halved.

CHIMERIC MASTERY

Requirements: you must have mastered Vivisectionist. Choose two creature Species among construct, demon, elemental, and undead. You can now use Spell Mimic to learn spells from creatures of the chosen Species. This Heroic Skill may be acquired up to twice, each time selecting two Species from the list above. Whenever you acquire this Skill, you also increase your upper limit for memorized Chimerist spells by 2.

CLEAN SLATE

Requirements: you must have mastered Symbolist.

You may use an action and spend up to 30 Mind Points to choose one creature you can see for every 5 MP spent this way. Each creature chosen this way recovers from all status effects and stops being affected by all spells with a duration of "Scene" that are affecting them.

COMEBACK KID

Requirements: You must have mastered the Strongman class, and you must have acquired the Acclaim skill.

When you first enter Crisis in a conflict, you gain Acclaim equal to your level. While in Crisis, you may spend Acclaim to reduce incoming damage by 3 for every Acclaim spent. If you use this Skill in a conflict, you cannot use it again until the start of your next turn.

COMEBACK MECHANICS

Requirements: You have mastered the Pugilist class.

While you are in Crisis:

  • Parry allows you to add a +1 or -1 bonus to your check after rolling it.
  • Clinch gains a +1 bonus to its Opposed Check.
  • Combo's mark now also increases your action's Damage by 2.
  • Combination gains a +2 bonus to its check.
  • Footwork gains one extra counter (may only happen once per scene).

THE PERIHELION

Requirements: you must have mastered Entropist. You learn the ultimate Entropist spell: The Perihelion.

The Perihelion — MP: 50 — Target: Special — Duration: Instantaneous You rip open a large portal to the Cosmos, calling down astral debris from the gaping void. Choose one option: you deal 60 damage to one enemy you can see; or you deal 40 damage to every enemy you can see. These amounts increase by 5 if you are level 20 or higher, or by 10 if you are level 40 or higher. Damage dealt by this spell has no type (thus being unaffected by damage Affinities).

COMPLICATED RELATIONSHIP

Requirements: You must have mastered the Socialite class.

Bonds you form and bonds formed toward you can now contain contradictory emotions (such as both hatred and affection at the same time) up to a maximum of 4 emotions in total.

CONSECRATED WEAPON

At any moment, if you have at least 4 Motes, you may spend 40 MP and imbue one equipped weapon with them. Until this spell ends, the weapon gains a +3 bonus to Accuracy Checks, and its damage ignores Resistances. The Motes used are destroyed.

If it's a melee weapon, it also becomes a ranged weapon, and its attacks can now be launched from afar. If you have that weapon equipped while casting this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action.

You can generate Motes as normal from the next turn onwards.

Only one weapon can benefit from this Skill at a time.

CONTAGION

Requirements: you must have mastered the Apothecary class.

As an action, choose one creature suffering from Affliction and another two targets you can see (if you also possess the Infectious Class skill you may choose up to three targets). The targets suffer the Affliction status condition, including all damage types from which the creature suffers. For example, if a creature suffered Affliction [Fire, Poison], the targets would also suffer Affliction [Fire, Poison]. This heroic skill can still be used if the target already suffers from the Affliction status condition, but would only gain those damage types from which they are not already suffering.

CROWD PLEASER

Requirements: You must have Mastered the Celebrity Class, and must have learned the Cultural Phenomenon skill.

Outside of a Conflict, you may spend 3 Reputation Points and choose a crowd of non-hostile humanoid creatures able to hear and understand you. If you do, those creatures become swayed by your voice, and against even their better judgement will follow your commands for the remainder of the scene. This effect also ends when the crowd disperses and for each individual when they leave the crowd.

DEADLY RUSH

Requirements: You have mastered the Operative class.

Whenever you cause a creature to hit 0 HP, you may immediately perform an additional action. Increase the damage dealt by your attacks or spells against creatures in Crisis by 5.

DEEP POCKETS

Requirements: you must have mastered Engineer. You reduce Inventory Point costs by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

DEFENSIVE RITUALS

Requirements: You have mastered at least one class among the Ritualist and Guardian classes, and have the Spellcasting Assistant skill.

When you use the Guard action to provide cover for an ally; or when you prevent an ally from being the target of an action, you may spend 5 MP to apply the effects of Spellcasting Assistant towards the first spell they cast on their next Turn.

DEVASTATING COUNTER

Requirements: You have mastered the Pugilist class, and acquired either the Footwork or Parry skills.

When you use Footwork against a melee attack; or get a Perfect Parry, choose one: Immediately perform a Combination for free; or an unarmed Free Attack. Your attacker must be among your targets. If you use Devastating Counter during a conflict, you cannot use it again until the start of your next turn.

DISARMING RHETORIC

Requirements: you must have mastered Orator. During a conflict scene, you may use an action and choose a soldier-rank creature that can hear and understand you (the Game Master must tell you who is a valid target). If that creature is shaken or in Crisis, you may spend an amount of Mind Points equal to (20 + half that creature’s level) to have them peacefully leave the conflict. Describe how you convince them to desist.

DOUBLE ARROW

Requirements: you must have mastered Captain or Sharpshooter.

When you perform the Attack action with a ranged weapon that belongs to the bow Category, if you have no other weapon equipped, you may perform two separate attacks instead of one (against the same target or against different targets). If you do, both attacks follow the rules for two-weapon fighting: each attack loses the multi property and cannot gain it, and you treat the High Roll of each Accuracy Check as being equal to 0 when determining damage.

Note that this Heroic Skill does not stack with a custom weapon's quick customization (using Double Arrow with a quick bow does not allow for more than two attacks).

DUAL ASSASSINATION

Requirements: You have mastered the Operative class and acquired the Lethal Precision skill.

Whenever you perform the Lethal Precision skill, choose one: Target an additional creature; or repeat your Accuracy Check and keep the better result.

If both Accuracy Checks against the same target would have resulted in triggering an Assassination, increase the damage multiplier by one step (e.g. from x2 to x3, or x3 to x4).

DUEL MASTER

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Cartomancer, Fury, Rogue, Sharpshooter, and Prizefighter.

When you resolve the Magic Pair effect, if you attack with a weapon belonging to the arcane, dagger, firearm, sword, or thrown Category, you deal extra damage equal to (the common value of the resolved cards) and regain an amount of Mind Points equal to (twice the common value of the resolved cards). For instance, resolving a pair of 5s will allow you to deal 5 extra damage and regain 10 Mind Points.

DUNGEON EXTRAORDINAIRE

Requirements: you must have mastered the Antiquarian Class.

Once per dungeon, when you complete a stage, you can ask the Game Master a question or describe to them something you wish to know. They must offer you a complete answer, with no room for doubt. If for some reason the information is not possible to know or deduce, your Game Master may instead give you 1 Fabula Point.

EMERGENCY TREATMENT

Requirements: you must have mastered Physician.

When a creature first enters Crisis in a scene you are in, you may immediately perform the Inventory action to create and use one consumable on that creature. Once per scene.

EMPATHETIC

Requirements: None.

You gain 2 extra Bond slots. When you acquire this Heroic Skill, you may instantly create a Bond with 1 emotion tied to it. Additionally, the strength of your Bonds is always treated as being 1 point higher (for instance, a Bond with three emotions will have a strength of 4). If an effect would cause you to already have Bonds with a strength of 4 or more (such as through the Fettered Heart Quirk in the High Fantasy Atlas), you cannot benefit from the second paragraph of this Skill.

ENDURING WELLSPRING

Requirements: You must have mastered the Vampyre class, and must have acquired the Life Well Skill.

Your Life Well loses only half its stored HP after you finish a rest.

EXTRA HP

(no requirement) Permanently increase your maximum Hit Points by 10. The amount of additional HP increases to 20 if you are level 40 or higher.

EXTRA IP

(no requirement) Permanently increase your maximum Inventory Points by 4.

EXTRA MP

(no requirement) Permanently increase your maximum Mind Points by 10. The amount of additional MP increases to 20 if you are level 40 or higher.

EXTRA SPELLS

(no requirement) When you acquire this Skill, learn any two spells from one of the following lists: Elementalist, Entropist, or Spiritist. Both spells chosen this way must come from the same list, and they follow the standard rules for casting spells of that Class.

EXTRA TOOLS

Requirements: you must have mastered the Bounty Hunter Class and acquired the Hunter's Tools Skill.

You learn two extra tools from the Hunter's Tools list. Additionally, tools with a target of "Self" now have a target of "Yourself or an ally".

FABULA IMPETUM

Requirements: you must have mastered the Stalwart Class.

Once per scene, you may use an action and spend up to 2 Fabula Points to perform a free attack with a weapon you have equipped. For each Fabula Point spent this way, that attack gains a +2 bonus to its Accuracy Check and deals 10 extra damage. However, all damage dealt by this attack becomes light and its type cannot change. Damage dealt by this attack against Villains ignores Immunities and Resistances.

FLAWLESS POISE

Requirements: you must have mastered Fencer.

After you use the Guard action, each enemy that targeted you during that turn suffers damage equal to (5 × the strength of your Bond towards them, if any).

FORBIDDEN RITE

Requirements: you must have mastered Cartomancer or Arcanist, and reached Skill Level 3 in Magic Cards.

After you discard cards due to the Magic Cards Skill, if at least one of those cards is a joker, you may choose any number of non-joker cards in your discard pile and shuffle them into your deck.

You also add the following effect to your list of sets:

Forbidden Monarch — Set requirements: 4 cards of the same value, none of which is a joker, + 1 joker. You deal 777 damage to every enemy you can see; the type of this damage is light if (the common value of the 4 cards) is even, or dark if that value is odd. If there is a joker in your discard pile, the damage dealt by this effect ignores Immunities and Resistances.

GEOSWIMMER

Requirements: You must have mastered the Sapper Class, and must have acquired the Rogue's See You Later Skill.

You move through the Earth as shadows. When you sink into the ground with Earthmeld, you can choose to reappear as though you had used See You Later. You may take one willing creature with you when you do this.

GIANT SWING

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Dancer, Fury, Mutant and Pilot.

During a conflict, you may use an action to grab a willing ally you can see and throw them. If you do, perform a (DEX + MIG) or (MIG + INS) Open Check (if you acquired the Frenzy Skill, this Check triggers a critical success if both dice show the same number and the Check is not a fumble), and the ally being thrown performs a free attack. This free attack deals extra damage equal to the result of your Open Check, and inflicts weak on each creature hit. If the Open Check is a fumble or the free attack misses, the ally being thrown suffers physical damage equal to your current Might die size.

GLEANING

Requirements: you must have mastered Entropist or Reaper, and acquired Psychical Depletion and The Bulstrode Transfer.

When you cast the Psychical Depletion spell, you recover the full amount of Mind Points the target loses, instead of half. When you cast the The Bulstrode Transfer spell, you recover the full amount of Hit Points the target loses, instead of half. Psychical Depletion's Mind Point loss increases by 5 if you are level 20 or higher, and by 10 if you are level 40 or higher.

GRAND ENTRANCE

Requirements: You must have mastered the Strongman class.

You may spend a Fabula Point to enter into a scene you are not part of and apply the effects of an opportunity. Once you use this Skill, you may not do so again until you rest.

GREATER AKROMORPHOSIS

Requirements: you must have mastered Mutant and acquired Akromorphosis.

You gain the following benefits based on the current Category of your unarmed strikes.

  • Arcane, brawling, dagger, or thrown: your attacks with unarmed strikes treat the Defense of

each target as being equal to their current Insight die size.

  • Bow or sword: your attacks with unarmed strikes that target two or more creatures deal 5

extra damage.

  • Firearm or heavy: your unarmed strikes deal 5 extra damage to constructs, and 5 extra damage

to non-construct creatures that have at least one shield and/or martial armor equipped.

  • Flail or spear: you gain a +2 bonus to Defense, and your attacks with unarmed strikes may

target flying creatures.

If your unarmed strikes belong to more than one Category, you gain all the corresponding benefits.

GREATER ECDYSIS

Requirements: you must have mastered Mutant.

When you use the Ecdysis Skill, you may also choose one or both of the following options: you recover from all status effects; and/or you stop being affected by all spells with a duration of "Scene" that are currently affecting you.

GREATER THERIOMORPHOSIS

Requirements: you must have mastered Mutant.

When you use the Theriomorphosis Skill, you may manifest the effects of up to three therioforms from those you have learned (instead of two), and the free attack keeps its full High Roll.

HARVESTER

Requirements: You must have mastered one or more Classes among the following: Archivist, Slayer, or Wayfarer.

When you make an Accuracy Check and roll a critical success, you or another creature of your choice regains 1 Inventory Point.

HEARTBREAKER

Requirements: you must have mastered Blackguard. When you hit a creature with an attack, if that attack only targeted that creature and you have a Bond towards them, you may choose to spend half of your current Hit Points, rounded down. If you do, the attack deals extra damage equal to (10 multiplied by the strength of your Bond towards the target). You may use this Skill only on your turn during a conflict, and only once per turn.

HEROIC COMPANION

Requirements: you must have mastered Traveller and acquired Faithful Companion. You gain the following benefits: • The companion’s maximum Hit Points increase by 10. • The companion deals 5 extra damage. • Choose one of the companion’s Attributes: Dexterity, Insight, Might, or Willpower. The chosen Attribute is permanently increased by one die size (up to a maximum size of d12). • The companion gains an additional Skill. When you reach level 40, or if you have already reached it, the companion gains another additional Skill. Make sure to discuss your Skill choices with the Game Master and the other Players.

RESUSCITATIVE OFFICE

Requirements: you must have mastered Spiritist. You learn the ultimate Spiritist spell: Resuscitative Office.

Resuscitative Office — MP: 40 — Target: Special — Duration: Instantaneous You rekindle the flames of courage and hope within a defeated hero. Choose a Player Character who Surrendered but is still narratively present on the scene: that Player Character immediately regains consciousness and recovers an amount of Hit Points equal to their Crisis score. Note that this spell will not undo the consequences of the character’s Surrender and is of no use if the character left the surrounding area as part of them, such as if they were captured and dragged away, if they were trapped in a parallel dimension, and so on. A Player Character may only be affected by this spell once per scene. If a character is brought back into the conflict by this spell and is subsequently reduced to 0 Hit Points again, they must Sacrifice themselves or Surrender as per the normal rules (including a new consequence and 2 more Fabula Points if they Surrender).

HOPLITE

Requirements: you must have mastered Captain or Guardian.

As long as you have a weapon equipped in your main hand slot and a shield equipped in your off-hand slot, your attacks with that weapon deal 5 extra damage and you gain a +1 bonus to Defense.

This Skill cannot be combined with custom weapons, nor with the Dual Shieldbearer Skill.

HUMBLE STRENGTH

When you acquire this Heroic Skill, choose two different Attributes among Dexterity, Insight, Might, and Willpower: when you perform an Accuracy Check with a non- martial weapon (W), you may replace its Attributes with those you have chosen. As long as the only weapon you have equipped is a staff (the basic weapon found on page 130 of the Core Rulebook), that staff is treated as also belonging to the brawling, heavy, spear, and sword Categories for the sake of Skills and effects that require it, and your attacks with that weapon deal 10 extra damage. Additionally, when you perform an attack using an improvised weapon, you deal 5 extra damage and may have that weapon not be destroyed after the attack.

HUNT LEADER

Requirements: you must have mastered Orator.

This Skill has three effects. If you have the Lockdown Skill and the Condemn Skill, you may use the Lockdown Skill when you successfully use the Condemn Skill against a creature. When you use the Encourage Skill on an ally, you may apply a bane oil to a weapon they have equipped as part of the same action (still paying the 2 Inventory Points). When you use the Encourage Skill on an ally, you may use the Know Thy Quarry Skill for that ally's Checks until the start of your next turn.

HUNTER'S INSTINCT

Requirements: you must have mastered the Bounty Hunter Class and acquired the Bounty Skill.

After you roll a Check, you may spend 1 Fabula Point to invoke your Bounty as an Instinct. If you do, that Check triggers a critical success if both dice show the same number (and the Result is not a fumble). Additionally, damage dealt by your tools now ignore Resistances against all creatures (not just against your Bounty), and also ignore Immunities against creatures that are your Bounty.

HUNTER'S TRICK

Requirements: you must have mastered Prizefighter.

When you transform a transforming custom weapon on your turn, choose one option: if you have performed no attacks this turn, your next attack with that weapon this turn deals 5 extra damage; or if you have already hit one or more creatures with it this turn, you recover 5 Hit Points and 5 Mind Points.

IMPECCABLE PHYSIQUE

Requirements: You must have mastered one or more classes among Fury, Guardian and Strongman.

You are immune to your choice of either dazed, shaken, slow, or weak. Whenever an effect would cause you to suffer a status effect you are immune to, you instead recover 5 Hit Points or Mind Points.

IMPLANTED INSTINCTS

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Butcher and Vivisectionist, and acquired both the Fleshcraft and Spell Mimic Skills.

When you use the Fleshcraft skill on an NPC, the Game Master must reveal all spells known by that NPC. Then, if that NPC knows one or more spells, you may learn one of those spells as a Vivisectionist spell of your own, even if that NPC's Species is not among those you can learn spells from with the Spell Mimic Skill.

INNER WELLSPRING

Requirements: you must have mastered Dowser.

Carry an elemental wellspring of your choice within yourself.

INSPIRING PRESENCE

Requirements: you must have mastered Orator. Once per turn, when you use the My Trust in You Skill during an ally's Accuracy Check or Magic Check for an offensive spell (O), you may have that attack or spell deal 5 extra damage. When you use the Unexpected Ally Skill on a creature, you may have that creature become a follower of your group until your group gains another follower. Followers are always willing to help the group in dangerous situations; during conflict scenes, they follow the rules for NPCs as Special Abilities in the Game Master's Booklet (page 17). Essentially, the NPC does not have a dedicated profile and is instead represented by a passive benefit for the group, or by an active or reactive benefit that can be used two or three times per conflict scene. The specific benefits granted by a follower are created together by the entire group, and the Game Master has final say on them.

INSURANCE POLICY

Requirements: you must have mastered Physician.

The first potion you create each scene costs 0 Inventory Points.

INTO THE OTHERWORLD

Requirements: None

When you first acquire this Heroic Skill, choose one of your Attributes, as well as either an offensive (O) spell you know or a Skill you know that allows you to use an action and make a free attack (such as the Blackguard’s Shadow Strike or the Commander’s Queen’s Gambit). If you choose a Chimerist spell this way, you cannot forget that spell and it no longer counts against the maximum number of Chimerist spells you can learn. On your turn during a conflict, while you are in Crisis, you may use an action and spend 40 Mind Points to open your otherworld — a special pocket dimension reflecting your psyche that you overlay onto reality. Describe what it looks like!

You also gain an Otherworld Clock, which has 4 segments and begins full. At the end of each of your turns while your otherworld is open, erase one segment of your Otherworld Clock. Additionally, whenever you take damage, roll your Willpower die. If the result is 3 or lower, erase one segment of your Otherworld Clock. When you erase the last segment of your Otherworld Clock, erase the Clock and your otherworld closes. Your otherworld also closes at the end of the current scene or if you are reduced to 0 Hit Points. Sections of the Otherworld Clock may not be filled nor erased in any way except as indicated above.

When you open your otherworld, do each of the following: • Choose any number of other creatures present on the scene. You and the chosen creatures become contained within your otherworld. All other creatures remain outside your otherworld. • You may perform an additional action this turn. This action must be the action chosen when you acquired this Heroic Skill.

While your otherworld is open, the following effects apply: • When you cast the spell or perform the free attack chosen when you acquired this Heroic Skill, the Magic Check or Accuracy Check automatically succeeds, and the HR is treated as 5. • You treat your die for the Attribute chosen when you acquired this Heroic Skill as being one size higher, to a maximum of d12.

IRON FOREST

Requirements: you must have mastered Captain or Prizefighter.

When you hit one or more creatures with a melee attack using a weapon that belongs to the spear Category, if you have no other weapon equipped, you may spend 20 Mind Points and choose one of those creatures. If you do so, the attack deals half the normal amount of damage to each of its targets, and you choose one type of action among the following: Attack, Guard, Objective, Spell, or Skill. From now on, the chosen creature must spend 10 Mind Points whenever they wish to perform that type of action. If they can't, they must perform a different type of action. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn, or until you use this Skill again.

JUDGE OF CHARACTER

Requirements: You must have mastered the Evangelist class.

The first time you encounter a character, you immediately learn one of their dark traits if they possess at least one.

KITCHEN SCRAPS

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Butcher and the Cook, and acquired both the Cooking and Waste Not Skills.

When you prepare a delicacy, you may gain a portion of leftovers - a special ingredient that has all of the tastes used in the delicacy, and spoils at the end of the scene. When you use a portion of leftovers to prepare a delicacy, choose one of its tastes. It becomes an ingredient of the chosen taste, losing its other tastes. When you prepare a delicacy using a portion of leftovers, you cannot gain a portion of leftovers, and you may only carry one portion of leftovers at any time.

KNOW THY ENEMY

Requirements: You must have been responsible for a Villain’s redemption or demise.

When you acquire this Heroic Skill, select a Villain that follows the requirement. You gain an extra bond slot and create a bond towards that Villain, discussing the emotions with your group. Then, together with your group, you create and acquire that Villain’s Legacy. That Legacy represents something your Character has learned thanks to that Villain’s actions. It could be one of their iconic moves, a piece of rare equipment or a whole new Skill altogether.

KNOW YOUR ENEMIES

Requirements: You must have mastered the Unchained class, and must have learned the Guerilla skill.

In addition to ignoring resistances, the Guerrilla effect now allows you to ignore immunities and absorptions of the targets on which it is applied.

LEGENDARY METAL

Requirements: You must have mastered the Sapper Class.

You have learned the music that stone and metal can make even when they are separated from Mother Earth. You may spend a Fabula Point to reveal a location where the party can find any type of rock or metal that originates from your world, or that you have extensive experience with. However, this Skill will not warn you of any challenges or dangers that may lie between you and the mineral you crave.

LESSER, GREATER, MIDDLING

Requirements: You must have mastered the Evangelist class, and must have learned the Resolve or Righteous Fury skills.

If an enemy has at least 1, their number of dark traits is considered to be 4 for the effects of your Righteous Fury and Resolve skills.

LIKE AN OPEN BOOK

Requirements: you must have mastered Esper, Archivist, or Rogue, and acquired Soul Steal.

After you successfully use the Soul Steal Skill against one or more enemies, you may choose one of them. If you do, you immediately perform the Study action for free against that enemy: treat the Result and High Roll of this Open Check as being equal to the Result and High Roll of the Check you performed for Soul Steal (do not roll dice for this Open Check).

When you deal damage to an elite or champion-rank enemy, if you stole that enemy's soul treasure during this scene, you deal extra damage equal to (your Skill Level in Soul Steal) to that enemy.

LITHOMETRY

Requirements: You must have mastered the Sapper Class, and must have acquired the Esper's Psychic Gift Skill.

You have made contact with the slumbering consciousness of the Earth itself. You can begin a ritual that will let you see and hear everything that happened in contact with the Earth at a particular time in the past, continuing up to ten minutes from that moment. This Ritual requires an object that was present at the time and place you want to observe, the associated Magic Checks are (WLP + WLP), and the length of the Clock depends on how long ago that time you're observing was. Once you have done this, the Earth will need to rest, and you will not be able to ask about the same place again. While it calls for intense focus, this Ritual can be performed quietly and subtly. Once it is complete, you are considered to have been present at the time for the purposes of Skills like the Loremaster's Trained Memory, but you can't witness anything that wasn't touching the Earth.

LITTLE TREAT

Requirements: None.

When you create a potion or delicacy (see Gourmet) that causes one or more allies to recover Hit Points and/or Mind Points, you may recover half of the value in Hit Points and/or Mind Points that the potion or delicacy recovers. You cannot benefit from this effect if the potion or delicacy already causes you to recover Hit Points and/or Mind Points.

MAGICAL SABOTAGE

Requirements: You must have mastered the Unchained class, you must know a spell or be able to use Rituals, and must have learned the Saboteur skill.

The bonus granted by Saboteur also applies when you interfere with a Ritual or a magical effect.

MALEVOLENT MALEDICTIONS

Requirements: You must have mastered the Vampyre class, and must have acquired the Crimson Malediction Skill.

Before you cast a malediction, you may double its HP cost to alter one of the conditions to lift it.

MANA LINK

Requirements: You have mastered the Ritualist class.

Whenever you Rest, you may create a Mana Link between yourself and a willing ally. All previous Mana Links are lost when you create a new one. The Mana Link is also lost if either part of the link dies.

While the Mana Link remains active, both of you gain the following benefits as long as you are able to see or hear each-other:

  • When you Cast a Spell, you may choose one from that ally's list of spells.
  • When you recover MP, you may instead recover half as much MP and have that ally recover the other half.
  • When that ally spends or loses MP, you may pay for up to half of that cost.

If either activates a benefit from Mana Link, the other may do the same until that effect is fully resolved.

MASTER OF THE GREATSWORD

Requirements: you must have mastered Prizefighter.

Swords join the list of weapons that trigger a critical success with the Frenzy Skill. While you have a two-handed sword equipped, you may spend one Opportunity to perform a free attack with it, dealing 5 extra damage and generating no Opportunities (once per round). When your two-handed sword causes one or more creatures to lose Hit Points, you may spend 1 Fabula Point to reduce one non-Villain among them — whose current Hit Points are at or lower than your Crisis score — to 0 Hit Points.

MATHEMAGIC

Requirements: you must have mastered Archivist. When you cast a spell with a target of “One creature”, you may choose an Attribute (Dexterity, Insight, Might, or Willpower) and a die size (d6, d8, d10, or d12). If you do, the spell’s target becomes “Every creature present on the scene whose current die size in that Attribute matches your choice” and its total Mind Point cost is doubled. Additionally, all mentions of “the target” in the spell’s text are replaced with “each target”; or they are replaced with “one or more targets” if the spell is Aberrant Susceptibility, Dissolution, Aldworth's Compress, or Specular Reversion. When the spell ends on one or more of its targets, it automatically ends on all its targets. If you cast an offensive spell (O) this way, you perform a single Magic Check and compare it to the Magic Defense of each target.

MERCILESS ASSAULT

Requirements: you must have mastered the Malefactor, and must have learned the Exploit Skill.

When you use your action to use the Exploit Skill, you may spend an additional 10 Mind Points to focus your Exploit onto only one creature, chosen when you do so. Rather than choosing a status effect, all status effects are Exploited. At the beginning of your future turns this conflict the target suffers (SL × the number of status effects on the target) damage of the same type as one of your equipped weapons (if none, physical). This counts as your single Exploited status effect. You can use an action on future turns to begin Exploiting as normal (choosing an applicable status effect), or spend 10 Mind Points to change the target of your Merciless Assault to them.

MIRACLE TONIC

Requirements: you must have mastered Physician.

As an action, spend 6 Inventory Points: one creature permanently gains +10 maximum Hit Points, +10 maximum Mind Points, or +5 of each — the target's choice. You can use this Skill on any given creature only once ever.

MONKEY GRIP

Requirements: you must have mastered Fury. You may now equip two-handed weapons belonging to the flail, heavy, spear, and sword Categories within a single hand slot. Additionally, the first attack you perform with a two-handed weapon during each turn deals 5 extra damage, and its damage ignores Resistances.

MONOPOLY

Requirements: you must have mastered Proprietor.

You gain one additional free use of one of your organisation's abilities as part of your Incorporate Skill per session.

MUTATION RITUAL

Requirements: you must have mastered the Mutant Class, and must have acquired the Ecdysis Skill.

After you acquire a Resistance to a damage type through the Ecdysis Skill, if that damage type is air, bolt, earth, fire or ice, you may perform Elementalism Rituals related to that damage type. If you do, you may spend Hit Points instead of Mind Points for the Ritual (but not both at the same time). You cannot perform the Ritual if doing so would reduce you to 0 Hit Points.

NETWORK CONNECTION

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Esper and Batman, and acquired the Navigator Skill.

You may apply the effects of the Arming Maneuver, Hero's Right Hand, and Team Player Skills to your cognitive focus, as long as you have a Bond with them and you are able to hear each other.

OATH OF VENGEANCE

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Blackguard, Fury and Batman.

When using the Heart of Darkness Skill, you may create a Bond of hatred or a Bond of inferiority; you may also use Heart of Darkness to strengthen an existing Bond, provided the only emotion in that Bond is hatred or inferiority. When you deal damage to a creature toward whom you have a Bond of hatred and/or inferiority, you deal additional damage equal to your Bond strength with that creature.

ON MY ACCOUNT

Requirements: you must have mastered Penny Knight.

While in the Panoply, when a creature you hold a Bond of admiration, loyalty or affection toward spends Mind Points to cast a spell or perform a Ritual, you may pay up to (Bond strength × 10) of that cost for them. Only one patron per casting.

PASO DOBLE

Requirements: you must have mastered Dancer.

Your attacks deal 5 extra damage for every enemy within 2 squares of your target.

PENUMBRAL PATRICIAN

Requirements: You must have mastered the Vampyre class.

While in heavy shadows or darkness and not in a conflict, you recover 5 HP every few minutes.

PERFECT AIM

Requirements: you must have mastered Sharpshooter and acquired Warning Shot. When you use the Warning Shot Skill, you may choose two different options instead of one (for instance, you could inflict both shaken and slow on each creature, or inflict a status effect on each creature while also lowering their Mind Points).

PERFECT CLARITY

Requirement: You must have mastered the Clarity skill (SL 3).

Whenever you have at least 4 active Motes, you also receive a +1 bonus to your Defense, Magical Defense, and Accuracy Checks.

PHAGOMAGUS

Requirements: you must have mastered Chimerist, Entropist, Gourmet, or Mutant.

When you cast the Dissolution spell, its Mind Point cost becomes "10 × T" and its target becomes "Up to three creatures". When you cause one or more enemies to stop being affected by one or more spells with a duration of "Scene", choose one option: you recover 20 Mind Points for each different spell whose effects ended on at least one of those enemies this way; or for each different spell whose effects ended on at least one of those enemies this way, apply a copy of that spell on yourself (if a spell allowed for choices upon casting it, you must retain the same choices made for that casting). This copying effect does not require actions, Mind Points, or Checks, and is not treated as "casting a spell".

PILLAGE

Requirements: you must have mastered Rogue and acquired Soul Steal. When you use the Soul Steal Skill, you may target any number of enemies at the same time. You perform a single Check and compare it to the Magic Defense of each creature you are attempting to steal from.

POLARITY

Requirements: you must have mastered Dancer.

You deal extra damage equal to (the difference between your current HP and your maximum HP, divided by 10) with all of your attacks.

FLAWLESS POISE (Fencer heroic, also available to Dancer)

Requirements: you must have mastered Dancer.

After you use the Guard action, each enemy that targeted you during that turn suffers damage equal to (5 × the strength of your Bond towards them, if any).

POUND OF FLESH

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Butcher and Rogue, and acquired both the Amputate and Soul Steal Skills.

After you successfully use the Soul Steal Skill against one or more enemies, you may choose one of them. If you do, you immediately use the Amputate Skill against that enemy: treat the Result and High Roll of its check as being equal to the Result and High Roll of the Check you performed for Soul Steal (do not roll dice for this Check). When you steal an enemy's soul treasure, you recover Mind Points equal to (four times your Skill Level in Soul Steal).

POWER CHORD

Requirements: you must have mastered Chanter.

When you sing a verse with medium or high volume, you may double the verse's cost in Mind Points, or spend 1 Fabula Point. If you do, you and every ally that is able to hear you gain the following benefit until the start of your next turn: your Accuracy Checks trigger a critical success when both dice show the same number (as long as the Check is not a fumble).

POWERFUL SHOT

Requirements: you must have mastered Sharpshooter. Your ranged attacks deal 5 extra damage. The amount of extra damage increases to 10 if you are level 40 or higher.

POWERFUL SPELL

Requirements: you must have mastered Vivisectionist, Elementalist, Entropist, or Spiritist. Spells you cast deal 5 extra damage. The amount of extra damage increases to 10 if you are level 40 or higher.

POWERFUL STRIKE

Requirements: you must have mastered Fury or Prizefighter. Your melee attacks deal 5 extra damage. The amount of extra damage increases to 10 if you are level 40 or higher.

PREDICTABLE!

Requirements: you must have mastered Archivist. During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 20 Mind Points to anticipate the upcoming moves of a creature you can see, as long as you know two or more of that creature’s Traits. If you do so, choose one type of action among the following: Attack, Guard, Objective, Spell, or Skill. Until the start of your next turn, the creature must spend 20 Mind Points whenever they wish to perform that action. If they can’t, they must perform a different action.

PUNISHER STANCE

Requirements: you must have mastered Prizefighter.

When you perform the Guard action (provided you did not Guard on your previous turn), choose ranged attacks or offensive spells. Until the start of your next turn: Counterattack triggers on all melee attack hits and misses regardless of parity; the free attacks from Counterattack deal 5 extra damage when the triggering attack hit you; and Counterattack also triggers on hits and misses from the chosen category.

QUARTERSTAFF MASTERY

Requirements: None

While you have a non-martial, melee, two-handed brawling weapon equipped, your attacks with it deal 5 extra damage, may target flying creatures, and you treat it as belonging to the spear and sword Categories for the sake of Skills that require it. When you perform the Attack action and choose to attack with this weapon, you may perform two attacks (against the same target or against different ones). If you do, both attacks follow the rules for two-weapon fighting (see Core Rulebook, page 69), and you ignore the 5 extra damage you would normally receive from this Skill for each of the attacks.

QUICK SCAN

Requirements: you must have mastered Archivist.

When you perform the Study action during a conflict, you may examine the profiles of all enemies you can see. If you do, you perform a single (INS + INS) Open Check and apply the result separately to each enemy (Core Rulebook, page 319). However, if you have acquired the Flash of Insight Skill, this Check cannot trigger it.

RAISING

Requirements: you must have mastered Reaper.

You can raise one non-Villain creature of the beast, monster or plant Species — which must die while you can see it — as a minion. When you raise it, spend 2 Grave Points; your maximum Hit Points and maximum Mind Points are both reduced by an amount equal to that creature's level (this reduction ends when you lose the minion). The raised creature's Species becomes undead; its Rank becomes Soldier; it keeps its Skills; it arrives at full Hit Points and Mind Points with its original equipment. It acts on telepathic command on its own turn. The Game Master counts it as an additional Player Character when designing conflicts. It rests when you rest. You lose it if it is reduced to 0 Hit Points, if it is more than one travel day away from you, if you die or fall unconscious, or if you choose to destroy it. Only one at a time.

RAMPART

Requirements: you must have mastered Guardian. During the first round of each conflict scene, you gain Resistance to all damage types and cannot suffer status effects (you do not recover from preexisting status effects, however). These benefits only last until the end of the first round.

RANCOR & REFRAIN

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Blackguard and Sin-Eater.

When a rule or ability requires you to spend a Fabula Point, you may instead choose a Bond and replace an emotion of Admiration, Affection, or Loyalty with one of Inferiority, Mistrust, or Hatred. If you do, ignore that cost.

RELIC REPOSITORY

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Antiquarian and Tinkerer, and must have learned the Vast Collection skill.

When you use your Vast Collection feature, you can choose an Artifact of your choice that you have seen or heard of before. You create a temporary copy of the item, that functions exactly as the item would have, for a short time. When you acquire an Artifact in this way, the duration it may stay is determined by the Game Master, rather than till the end of the scene.

An incredibly potent Artifact like the Final Feather may only last a few moments, whereas something more like the Astroscope may last for a few days.

REPETITION

Requirements: you must have mastered Orator. Once per turn during a conflict, after you use the Condemn Skill or the Encourage Skill, you may perform that same Skill again (on the same creature or a different one). You must still pay the Mind Point cost for the second use of the Skill.

REPRISAL

Requirements: you must have mastered Prizefighter.

After an enemy deals damage to you while you are in Crisis: you may spend 10 Mind Points to apply the Bone Crusher Skill's effects against them if they would be a legal target for a melee weapon you are wielding; and/or you may spend 10 Mind Points to apply the Warning Shot Skill's effects against them if they would be a legal target for a ranged weapon you are wielding.

RESTLESS EMOTIONS

Requirements: You must have mastered one or more Classes among the Socialite, Orator or Spiritist class.

Add the strength of the bonds you share with the target/the source of every heal effects or damages you deal or receive.

REVELATION

Requirements: you must have mastered Arcanist. You make contact with an unknown Arcanum and bind it to your soul. This Arcanum must be something you design together with the rest of the group; as long as you live, no one else in your world will be able to bind that Arcanum. Once per scene while you are merged with an Arcanum, you may use an action and spend 2 Fabula Points to trigger that Arcanum’s dismiss effect (if any) without dismissing them. Doing so does not trigger the Arcane Circle Skill (page 177).

RITUAL SEALS

Requirements: you must have mastered Symbolist.

When you perform a Ritual outside a conflict scene, if that Ritual has a total cost equal to or lower than 60 Mind Points, you may stop the process immediately before the Magic Check and store the Ritual's effect inside a Ritual seal placed on a surface you can touch. If you do, name a condition — this can be anything from "when I enter Crisis" to "as soon as I snap my fingers". When that condition is met, the seal vanishes and the Ritual is unleashed at the seal's location: then, you perform the Magic Check and resolve the effects as normal (even if you are unconscious or not present on the scene). You may only have one Ritual seal active at the same time — if you die or create a new Ritual seal, the one you previously created will vanish.

SEE YOU IN HELL

Requirements: you must have mastered Blackguard.

As long as your current Hit Points are lower than your maximum Hit Points, you may use an action and spend 20 Mind Points to deal an amount of dark damage equal to (10 + (the difference between your maximum Hit Points and your current Hit Points, divided by two)) to one enemy you can see. The type of this damage cannot change, and it ignores Absorptions, Immunities, and Resistances.

SEISMIC SENSES

Requirements: You must have mastered the Sapper Class, and must have acquired the Well-Traveled Skill.

Your long experience as a traveler has sharpened your mystical senses. When you roll a 6, 7, or 8 on a travel roll, you get a brief warning if there is something dangerous is ahead. If the danger leaves an impression on the ground, such as creatures approaching overland or a rockslide threatening, the GM will give you a hint. If not, you will only have the sense of approaching danger. Either way, each member of the party gets the chance to take the Equip, Inventory, or Guard action before the encounter begins.

SHOWSTOPPER

Requirements: you must have mastered Dancer.

After you use a Spell action during a conflict, each enemy within 3 squares of you suffers one status effect of your choice (dazed, enraged, poisoned, shaken, slow, or weak) until the end of your next turn.

SILENT HUNTER

Requirements: you must have mastered Naturalist or Prizefighter.

When you perform a free attack through the High Speed Skill with a bow, spear or thrown weapon, that attack deals extra damage equal to (your Skill Level in High Speed × 5). Additionally, when you attack one or more creatures with a bow, spear or thrown weapon, those creatures cannot perform free attacks until the end of the current turn.

SINISTER RUNES

Requirements: you must have mastered Reaper.

When you use the Runic Spell Skill, you may also cast a second spell as a runic spell, naming a separate and distinct trigger different from the first. The second runic spell's total Hit Point and/or Mind Point cost must be equal to or lower than the first runic spell's total cost.

SKILLFUL DOSAGE

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Cook, Archivist, Merchant, and Tinkerer.

Potions and delicacies you create, as well as spells you cast, can now cause creatures to recover Hit Points and Mind Points beyond their maximum HP and MP scores. This cannot cause a creature's current HP and/or MP to go above 150% of the respective maximum scores; at the end of each scene, if the current Hit Points and/or Mind Points of a creature are still above their maximum scores, they become equal to the maximum score.

SKYJUMP

Requirements: You must have learned Ballistic Extension (Core Rulebook, page 189). You may not acquire this Heroic Skill if another Player Character in your group has already acquired it. You may use an action and spend 10 Mind Points to become airborne. As long as you are airborne, your melee attacks can target creatures that cannot normally be targeted by melee attacks, and other creatures are unable to see you. At the start of your turn, if you are airborne, you stop being airborne and, until the end of that turn, you may ignore the Mind Point cost of the Ballistic Extension spell. If you cast Ballistic Extension during that turn and attack with a spear, the attack gains multi (2) and deals another 10 extra damage.

SPECIALTY OF THE HOUSE

Requirements: you must have mastered Cook.

Prepare a unique delicacy with alternative effects.

SPIRIT OF THE LAW

Requirements: you must have mastered the Magistrate.

Whenever you enact a law, you may spend 1 Fabula Point (in addition to the Mind Point cost) to apply a rule of your own design instead of a prewritten law that you know. Describe the condition that characters in the scene must adhere to. The Game Master has final say on what constitutes an acceptable law.

STABILIZED MUTATION

Requirements: you must have mastered Mutant, and acquired Theriomorphosis.

When you acquire this Heroic Skill, you learn two therioforms of your choice. When you rest, choose up to two therioforms among those you know; you cannot choose polypoda, and can only choose one among arpaktida, dynamotheria, and tachytheria. The chosen therioforms become stabilized until you rest again. As long as you are not manifesting any non-stabilized therioforms, you are treated as if you were manifesting both your stabilized therioforms and receive their benefits (these benefits do not end between scenes, nor if you perform the Guard action). As long as you are manifesting one or more of the following therioforms, you also gain Resistance to the corresponding damage type: amphibia (ice), electrophora (bolt), placophora (earth), pneumophora (air), pyrophora (fire), toxicophora (poison).

STATUS IMMUNITY

Requirements: you must have mastered Traveller. You are permanently immune to a single status effect of your choice among dazed, enraged, poisoned, shaken, slow, and weak.

STRENGTH OF FIVE WELLSPRINGS

Requirements: you must have mastered Dowser.

You may declare multiple Wellsprings of different types.

SUPER FANCLUB

Requirements: You must have Mastered the Celebrity Class, and must have learned the Call Entourage skill.

Together with the rest of your group, design a level 10 humanoid, and reduce their Maximum Hit Points and Mind Points by 50%. Those new statistics become one of your Entourage Members.

SUPER-ARMORED PAYBACK

Requirements: You have mastered the Pugilist class.

While wearing Martial Armor and after you are hit by an attack, your checks against your attacker gain a +3 bonus until the end of your next turn.

SURPRISE GIFT

Requirements: You must have mastered the Confidence Man class and know Trick or Treat Skill.

When using Trick or Treat, you roll twice and choose which result to apply.

SWIRLING SWARM

Requirements: you must have mastered Dancer.

When you use a Skill action and you are surrounded by three or more enemies, you may move up to 3 squares and perform a free attack.

TABULA RASA

Requirements: you must have mastered Captain.

After you use Bishop's Edict or King's Castle Skills, if you are in Crisis, you may have every enemy creature present on the scene lose 10 Hit Points. This amount increases to 20 Hit Points if you are level 20 or higher, or 30 Hit Points if you are level 40 or higher.

TACTICAL LAUNCH

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Captain, Guardian and Batman, and acquired the Tactical Leverage Skill.

When you use the Tactical Leverage Skill on an ally, they may gain two benefits from the Skill, instead of just one. Additionally, if you have a shield equipped, you may forgo the benefits of covering your ally to have them be treated as flying until the end of their next turn, provided they meet the conditions for flying.

TALISMANIC MASTERY

Requirements: you must have mastered Arcanist, Merchant, Symbolist, or Spiritist, and acquired Symbolism.

When you use the Symbolism Skill during a conflict, you may spend 20 Mind Points to ignore the Skill's normal cost in Inventory Points.

When you perform a free attack with a melee weapon as part of the Symbolism Skill, the attack may target enemies that cannot be targeted by melee attacks.

TEMPEST STRIKE

Requirements: you must have mastered Prizefighter. When you perform a melee attack with the multi property, you gain a bonus to your Accuracy Check equal to the value of that multi property, and the attack deals 5 extra damage. If the attack targets only one creature, it deals another 5 extra damage.

THE CONVERGENCE

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Elementalist, Entropist, Spiritist, and Sin-Eater.

Choose a damage type among air, bolt, dark, earth, fire, ice, light, or poison.

When you deal air, earth, fire, or ice damage, you gain a spirit orb associated with that damage type. You may only have one of each type of spirit orb at a time, and they vanish at the end of the scene.

When you have one of each type of spirit orb, you have access to a unique spell.

Upon casting this spell, your spirit orbs vanish and you must replace one of your Bond's emotions of Admiration, Affection, or Loyalty with one of Inferiority, Mistrust, or Hatred. If you don't, this spell has no effect.

The Convergence — MP: 50 · Target: Special · Duration: Instantaneous. Every enemy you can see suffers 10 earth damage, then 10 ice damage, then 10 fire damage, then 10 air damage. Finally, those enemies suffer (10 + the total number of Inferiority, Mistrust, and/or Hatred emotions among your Bonds) damage of the type you chose.

THE PERFECT DISTRACTION

Requirements: You have mastered the Mountebank class and have obtained either the Witty Remark or Patter skills.

Once per Scene and immediately after a Check gets a result other than a Critical Success, you may spend 1 Fabula Point and yell out some fake threat: This causes a distraction big and shocking enough to turn it into a Fumble.

If there is a Villain present in the scene, they may spend 1 Ultima Point to cause the threat to actually be real, and a problem for everyone involved. Including them. But especially you.

THE PRESTIGE

Requirements: you must have mastered Illusionist.

You learn the ultimate Illusionist spell: The Prestige.

The Prestige · 50 MP · Special · Special

You can now have up to 4 active Phantasms, but one of them must necessarily be Numen. Also, you cannot have more than one Numen Phantasm active at a time. This Phantasm cannot be used in any of the Illusionist's Skills or Command spells. Numen is bound by the same set of special rules as any other Phantasm, with the following exceptions:

  • The Prestige costs 50 MP to cast.
  • It can be targeted by the enemy, and has the same HP as its caster.
  • Once active, Numen has its own turn and a single action. Numen's turn can be taken either before or after the Illusionist's turn.
  • It cannot be targeted by allies.
  • After 3 turns, it shatters.

When creating a Numen Phantasm, choose one essence, which dictates Numen's damage type:

NumenDamage type
RavanaPhysical
AsuraLight
DiablosDark

The target hit by Numen suffers (HR + 14) damage. This damage increases to 18 if you are level 20 or higher, or to 20 if you are level 40 or higher. Damage dealt by Numen ignores Resistances and Immunities. The range of the attack is determined by your current weapon.

THE TRICK WEAPON

Requirements: you must have mastered Prizefighter, and you must have a transforming custom weapon equipped whose forms are one melee and one ranged.

You may use the Bone Crusher Skill and the Counterattack Skill with the ranged form of your transforming weapon, and the Crossfire Skill and the Warning Shot Skill with the melee form of your transforming weapon. After you use Bone Crusher or Warning Shot with the melee form, each enemy hit becomes ruptured until the end of the scene: a ruptured enemy suffers 5 extra damage and stops being ruptured the next time it takes damage from anything other than a melee attack. Ruptured is a primed condition — not a seventh status effect — and is private to this Heroic Skill. This Skill does not require mastery of Prizefighter; the class is required.

THE VIGIL

Requirements: you must have mastered Penny Knight.

While a Villain is present in the scene and/or you are in the Panoply, treat your Bond strengths as 1 higher. After a Game Master scene that depicts danger to a place or to non-Villain NPCs, you may spend 1 Fabula Point to declare your character felt it and knows where it is.

THEME SONG

Requirements: you must have mastered Chanter.

When you acquire this Skill, you obtain a theme song — give it a name and assign it a key from the ones you have learned. Once per conflict scene after you sing a verse in your theme song's key, you may start your theme song. While singing your theme song, you gain the following benefits:

  • You gain Resistance to (theme song's key type) damage.
  • When you deal (theme song's key type) damage, you deal 5 extra damage and the type of that damage cannot be changed.
  • The MP cost for singing verses in the same key as your theme song is halved. This benefit applies to you and any of your allies that are able to sing verses.

The theme song lasts until the end of the scene or until you leave the scene, die, or fall unconscious. The theme song also ends as soon as you sing a verse in a key other than the theme song's, if your turn ends and you have not sung any verse, or if another character starts their theme song.

THOROUGH ANALYSIS

Requirements: you must have mastered Archivist, and acquired Quick Assessment.

At the start of your turn during a conflict, choose one option: choose a creature you can see and the Game Master reveals one of their Traits; or name a damage type and choose a creature you can see, and the Game Master reveals that creature's Affinity towards that damage type.

TREASURE FIEND

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Antiquarian and Wayfarer, and must have learned both the Treasure Hunter and Treasure Magnet skills.

When you encounter a Danger as a result of a travel or encounter roll, you may spend a Fabula Point to, at the same time as the Danger, also make a Discovery. These two things may be one after the other or interwoven into the same scene, chosen by your Game Master.

TRICKY ATTACK

Requirements: You must have mastered the Confidence Man class.

When you make a weapon attack, you may instead disguise it as a feint and prepare a Secret Action with the trigger: "When the target next makes an attack roll." When triggered, you strike first, dealing 5 extra damage with your weapon attack. If the attack hits, the target suffers a −2 penalty to their next check.

TRIPLE SLASH

Requirements: you must have mastered Dancer.

When you use Bone Crusher, you may targets three enemies within 2 squares of each other instead of one.

TWILIGHT DISMISSAL

Requirements: you must have mastered Arcanist.

When you willingly dismiss an Arcanum on your turn, if that Arcanum had not been summoned during this same turn, you may choose dark, light, or physical. If you do, you and every ally you can see gain Resistance to the chosen damage type until the start of your next turn.

TWIN POINT STRIKE

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Sharpshooter, Batman and Prizefighter, and acquired the Arming Maneuver Skill.

When you perform the Arming Maneuver Skill and choose to both make a free attack with a weapon you have just equipped and to swap equipment with an ally, that ally may make a free attack alongside you. Both attacks treat their High Roll as 0 when calculating damage. Both attacks deal extra damage equal to your Skill Level in Arming Maneuver, and you generate an opportunity if any two of the four dice rolled in the two attacks show 6 or higher and match.

UNBREAKABLE

Requirements: you must have mastered Guardian. Once per scene when you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, you may instead choose to withstand the pain and be reduced to exactly 1 Hit Point.

UNSUSPECTED PERSONA

Requirements: You must have mastered one or more Classes among the Socialite or Rogue class.

When you have some spare time, you can spend 6 IP or a Fabula point to change into a fully unrecognizable appearance and demeanor, even for people who know you very well. Describe them and choose a name for this Persona. Until you reveal your real identity (by choice or by being forced to) nobody can recognize you. Brand new persona created with this skill have no background attached to them.

UPGRADE

Requirements: you must have mastered Engineer. When you rest, you may choose any number of weapons, armor, and/or shields among those owned by your group. For each item chosen this way, you may either add a Quality to it (if it does not have one) or replace its current Quality with a different one. These new Qualities must come from the list of default Qualities available for items of that type, and must have an associated cost modifier of +1000 zenit or lower. At the end of the rest, you must pay an amount of zenit equal to the total sum of those cost modifiers, reduced by (your Skill Level in Visionary, multiplied by 100). If you do, the items will be modified according to your choices. The default list of weapon Qualities can be found on page 269, while the default list of armor and shield Qualities can be found on page 280.

VAMPIRIC ELATION

Requirements: you must have mastered Esper or Mutant.

When you cause a creature to recover Hit Points through the Biophagy Skill or the Life Transference gift, that creature recovers 10 additional Hit Points and choose one option: they gain immunity to one status of their choice among poisoned, slow, and weak until the start of your next turn; or they gain Resistance to physical and poison damage until the start of your next turn.

VANISH

Requirements: you must have mastered Rogue. When you hit one or more creatures with an attack or offensive spell (O), you may spend 1 Fabula Point. If you do, each of those creatures becomes unable to see you until the start of your next turn.

VITAL MASTERY

Requirements: you must have mastered one or more Classes among Butcher, Sharpshooter, or Prizefighter, must have acquired the Surgical Slices Skill, and must have acquired one or more Skills among Melee Weapon Mastery or Ranged Weapon Mastery.

When you perform an attack, you may choose to forego the bonus from Ranged Weapon Mastery or Melee Weapon Mastery. If you do, that attack deals extra damage equal to (that bonus + your Skill Level in Surgical Slices).

PYROCLASTIC COLUMN

Requirements: you must have mastered Elementalist. You learn the ultimate Elementalist spell: Pyroclastic Column (if it better fits your character, you may give this spell a different name and change its damage to air, bolt, earth, or ice).

Pyroclastic Column — MP: 40 — Target: Special — Duration: Instantaneous You channel the fury of the planet into a powerful wave of fire and magma. Choose one option: you deal 50 fire damage to one enemy you can see; or you deal 30 fire damage to every enemy you can see. These amounts increase by 5 if you are level 20 or higher, or by 10 if you are level 40 or higher. Damage dealt by this spell ignores Resistances and Immunities.

WITCHVOICE

Requirements: you must have mastered Chanter or Orator.

After you sing a haunting verse, or after you succeed on an Opposed Check for your Condemn Skill, you may choose one enemy among the targets of that verse or Skill. Until your next turn or until that enemy loses the chosen status effect, that enemy is bewitched by your voice: it must include you among the targets of its attacks and offensive spells, if able.

WORDS OF LIGHT

Requirements: you must have mastered Orator or Spiritist.

When an ally deals damage, you may spend 1 Fabula Point: until the start of your next turn, all damage dealt by that ally becomes light and ignores Resistances.
